newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar down but off lows in late trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar down but off lows in late trade.

text.p: London white sugar futures ended weaker but off the day's lows on Monday in trading dominated by pre-expiry dealings in the nearby March/May spread.
March closed down $1.10 at $303.50 and May ended down $1.30 at $300.50. Overall volume amounted to 2,830 lots.
Buying of the spread by one leading trade house was countered by broker selling, which combined to push the value out to $3.30 at one point.
London followed the weakness on the New York market, but selling of the spot whites premium at just above $70 kept March/March within its recent range.
The Paris market was also weaker. March, which goes off the board on Friday, stood down 30 cents at $304.00 and May was $1.40 lower at $300.40.
